thread:
maria: Quick follow-up on the postmortem AIs from last week. Need owners + rough ETAs for remediations, + a pass on statuspage wording and customer-facing summary. Also spotted recurring cache-init failures across services. Can owners chime in?

leo: I can own the cache warmup fix (identified race between worker init and cache TTL refresh). Plan: patch to add init guard + staged deploy. ETA Mon (1778960000). Will attach canary success criteria.

sam: I'll take the customer-facing summary and redactable RCA draft. Draft ETA Wed EOD (1779030000). Will coordinate with Legal for redaction checklist.

kate: From Legal: please don't promise timelines to customers. Use "expected" or "anticipated" and include opt-in language for detailed RCAs. Also attach our redaction template before publishing.

aj: Proposed statuspage blurb (please edit):
```We experienced elevated request latency due to cache initialization errors impacting a subset of requests. Mitigations are rolling out; we expect service performance to stabilize. A full incident summary and RCA (with redaction options) will be published soon.```

maria: Nice. Two copy notes: 1) Link to the incident summary doc, 2) note on how customers can request an RCA (consent + redaction).

ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence-scan: cache-init pattern detected (4 occurrences in last 120 days). Related incidents: 1748004321, 1768129012, 1812356789, 1779991110. Suggest scheduling a recurrence review with SRE + Eng-ML.

legal-bot: legal-checklist-bot: required items before external RCA: redaction checklist, customer consent form, reviewer signoff. Link: https://legal.redwood/rca-checklist

leo: Canary gating I'll use: 95th latency <= baseline+15% for 48h on canary subset, error rate <0.5% across sampling window. If canary passes, then staggered rollout to 25/50/100 with 2h observation windows.

sam: Uploaded draft summary: https://drive.redwood/incident-drafts/1778888123 (please review; I left placeholders for customer-specific redactions).

maria: Action items recap: leo -> remediation rollout + gating (ETA Mon 1778960000). sam -> customer summary + RCA draft (ETA Wed EOD 1779030000). aj -> statuspage publish after Legal signoff and Sam's final. kate/legal-bot -> confirm redaction checklist and consent flow. devops/ops -> schedule recurrence review (by next Wed). I'll update the action tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/1778888123 and will sweep next Monday. Please reply in-thread for any changes. :eyes:
